page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance includes two integrated NVIDIA P4 GPUs, providing a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. It does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 6 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the instance pairs dedicated CPU resources with dual entry-level enterprise GPUs. The lack of local storage and the 6 Gbps network baseline represent architectural tradeoffs that require external storage solutions, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. The hardware profile is structured for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the cost overhead of high-end accelerator models.
Appropriate workloads for this configuration include small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, parallel processing tasks, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated computing.
